summary: Professional house share · Inclusive of all utilities · Single occupant only · Available July 2023
description: Large room in an occupied house share next to Ilford Road Metro Station, close to Jesmond and Gosforth. Suitable for a single occupant, this double bedroom is fully furnished and available for professional applicants. The property comes with a large shared living room, kitchen, bathrooms and sauna. The kitchen and carpets have been recently fitted, and the property has a bathroom and two showers. Included in the rent is council tax, gas and electric, water and broadband.
